title: GoodWe ESA GW6K-ETA-G20 (6 kW three-phase power module)

items.question: What backup rating does GW6K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: The GW6K-ETA-G20 has a rated apparent power of 6 kVA on the AC side (back-up port).
items.answer_de: Der GW6K-ETA-G20 hat eine Bemessungsscheinleistung von 6 kVA auf der AC-Seite (Back-up-Anschluss).

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: How many MPPTs does GW6K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: The GW6K-ETA-G20 has 3 MPPTs, with 1 string per MPPT.
items.question_de: Wie viele MPPTs hat der GW6K-ETA-G20?
items.answer_de: Der GW6K-ETA-G20 hat 3 MPPTs, mit 1 Strang pro MPPT.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: Which battery modules stack with this power module?
items.answer: The battery system includes GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20, and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Battery modules of different models can be mixed. The system supports 5-108kWh.
items.question_de: Welche Batteriemodule gehören zu diesem Leistungsmodul?
items.answer_de: Das Batteriesystem umfasst GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 und GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Batteriemodule verschiedener Modelle können gemischt werden. Das System unterstützt 5-108kWh.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)
